Container.Name: DVinyl
Container.Overview: A self-hosted, plugin based collection manager for your Vinyls, CDs, Books, Movies, Games and LEGO sets.
Container.Description: DVinyl is a self-hosted collection manager for physical media. Catalog, value and organize your music, books, movies, video games and LEGO sets from one customizable interface. Every media type is a plugin, so you enable only what you need. Note: Requires a separate MongoDB instance.
Container.Requires: MongoDB database. Install a MongoDB container first and link it via the MONGODB_URL variable. Recommended image: mongo:8.0 (pin a major version rather than :latest so an update never jumps a major and refuses to start on existing data). MongoDB 5.0+ needs a CPU with AVX support; on older hardware without AVX, use mongo:4.4.18 on a fresh database instead. Never point an older MongoDB at data files a newer version already wrote (downgrades are refused), and upgrade only one major at a time.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port DVinyl will be accessible on.

Config.Name: Uploads Volume
Config.Description: Directory to store uploaded files like covers.

Config.Name: MongoDB URL
Config.Description: Connection string for your MongoDB instance. Replace [IP_OF_MONGODB] with your MongoDB container IP or Unraid IP if hosted on the same custom network.

Config.Name: JWT Password
Config.Description: Password used for JWT token encryption.

Config.Name: HTTPS Production Mode
Config.Description: Change to true ONLY if you use HTTPS via a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Vinyl Port Variable
Config.Description: Internal port variable required by the app.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL for serving on a sub-path, leave empty to serve from root.

Config.Name: Discogs API Token
Config.Description: Your Discogs API Token for Vinyls/CDs.

Config.Name: Hardcover API Key
Config.Description: Your Hardcover API Key for Books.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Your TMDB API Key for DVDs.

Config.Name: Twitch Client ID
Config.Description: Your Twitch Client ID for Games.

Config.Name: Twitch Client Secret
Config.Description: Your Twitch Client Secret for Games.

Config.Name: Rebrickable API Key
Config.Description: Your Rebrickable API Key for LEGO sets.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer URL
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Your OIDC provider issuer URL (Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, pocketID...). Leave empty to disable SSO.

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. The client ID registered on your OIDC provider.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. The client secret registered on your OIDC provider.

Config.Name: OIDC Redirect URI
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Must exactly match the callback registered on your provider, always ending with /login/oidc/callback.

Config.Name: OIDC Button Label
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on. Text shown on the SSO login button, for example 'Sign in with Authentik'.
